findings.text: A queued live row now carries two placements at once, position/rank derived live from queued_placements at ordering.py:192 and queue_position/rank_key copied from the pointer, while this function's own docstring at query.py:425-427 states the place is derived once so surfaces cannot disagree; no field marks which pair is authoritative when a re-rank moves one and not the other.

The delivered change lives in admission/selection.py and query.py, neither of which is in the section's declared write paths, and the manifest records them under a scope_extension key the manifest contract does not define, so the coordinator has no accept-path record for two out-of-scope files.

The assertion compares the printed verdict detail against the gate state the test itself injected, so it can only fail if the code stops copying its own input; the load-bearing claims in that case are the held list and the unchanged pointers on the surrounding lines.

The fragment names only 13ab3de2 and 8cd68eaf as source commits, while the '64 tests' figure quoted in the same paragraph is produced at dde1c492, the query.py projection commit, so a reader following its provenance stops one commit short of the head it describes.
